objective: maximum total settled pre-tax net profit at equal stake per horse
selection_rule: maximize total net among policies positive in BOTH Apr-Jul and Aug-Dec temporal folds, each >=50 bets and positive after best-day removal; if none, retain best supported research candidate and abstain
deployment_gate: selection temporal stability; evaluation profit positive after 10% payout stress and after removing top 5 returns; selection profit > 0; evaluation >=200 bets and >=60 dates; date-bootstrap 95% ROI lower bound >0; profit remains >0 without best day
